analysis:
Examined all six primary analyses and every replayed patch/metadata unit; prior conclusions were not treated as proof. No independently supported security regression qualifies in the supplied evidence.

Cross-file checks resolve some local questions: ModelAutopilotPolicy.swift head 21–23 bounds holds to 0–86400 seconds and requires a load target, addressing the arithmetic concern in ProviderLoop+AutopilotPlacement.swift:68–69. Placement.swift:22–43 ties adopted serving to saved consent, selection, residency, retirement/self-test state and available hashes. Inventory.swift:15 retains advertisements only for valid adoption. An operation lease ending is not App Attest authorization expiring: TB-002/TB-011 independently require coordinator authorization and final handoff checks, so retained adoption alone does not establish a T-052/T-053 bypass. Busy.swift:11–33 retains transition/resource admission predicates while excluding the accepted operation itself. MTPUpgrade.swift:127 adds a loading occurrence without visibly removing load-gate cleanup. Added telemetry describes operational state rather than prompts or credentials. No replayed change modifies encryption, billing, cache scoping, token custody or privileged fan authority.

Material uncertainty remains because 39 source units are omitted from replay. Review the complete Autopilot command executor, InferenceHandler admission changes, transition watchdog and native completion paths to verify cancellation cannot publish a stale placement or release another operation's memory/load fence (T-010, TB-007). Check hold consumers in idle/LRU and cold-load budgeting against hard capacity and retirement constraints (T-029); Placement.swift:89–95 supplies saturating accounting but does not show its enforcement. Verify adoption invalidation across model/build changes and the changed serving callers (T-012/T-027), plus consent-gated telemetry producers. These are unresolved PR-specific contracts, not observed missing controls or proof of a full audit.
